comparisons.comparison: Both Morgan Stanley (MS) and Citigroup (C) disclose prior-period adjustments made to conform to current presentation standards, specifically driven by business realignments in 2023. MS recorded a $4,432 million decrease to interest income and expense within the Institutional Securities segment, while C transferred approximately $537 million in goodwill from Banking to Markets. Both explicitly state that prior-period amounts were revised to align with the new presentation structure.
